prompts.name: Quiet atelier
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-resolution cohesive UI design exploration board for Luvcraft, a playful procedural block-world and live creative workshop. Three reference images show the ACTUAL daytime game, current Material Library inventory and current metabar slider drawer. Use them as reference; retain the recognizable voxel world, cube material icons and actual features, but redesign the inconsistent overlays into one coherent widget family. Show a large in-game mockup with clean hotbar and restrained status, plus inventory and metabar inset mockups, and a compact component strip showing button, selected material tile, slider, toggle, tab, keycap and tooltip, with palette and typography samples. Legible concise labels: Material library, Natural, Building, Marble, Quickbar, Sky, Grading, Exposure, Shadows. Design for crisp native-resolution overlays above a lower-resolution world. Remove PID, heap, coordinates, chunks and streaming telemetry from the normal HUD; diagnostics belong in an optional drawer. Keep useful contextual hints short. No microtext walls, no arbitrary dashboard charts, no new gameplay features, no ornate fantasy borders. This is a PROPOSAL, not an implemented screenshot. Visually explain a reusable system rather than disconnected screens. Direction A: Quiet atelier. Warm bone surfaces, charcoal typography, muted moss selection, very restrained brass highlights. Calm precise typesetting, thin rules, small consistent corner radii, generous but efficient spacing. Feels like a lovely physical studio instrument rather than a web dashboard. Opaque panels without blur, crisp subtle shadows, cube icons keep their colorful material identities.
